Money movement that reconciles itself

Acme Payments runs the payout rails behind online marketplaces. We hold a double-entry ledger for every seller balance, move money to sellers in thirty-one countries, and reconcile every transfer against the bank file that settles it. Marketplaces plug in one API and stop building treasury software.

Our customers are marketplaces with between one thousand and one million sellers. They care about two things: that a payout arrives when promised, and that the numbers in their dashboard match the numbers in their bank account at the end of every day.
